note: 予約が使う Mapper の文の PostgreSQL での実行結果（tools/conformance/reservation_sql.py が生成する。手で編集しない）。statements は各段の SQL（#{…} を $n にしたもの）と束縛変数の名前・JDBC の型。seed は上流のシード（00230）を投入した MEMBER・MEMBER_LOGIN（LOGIN_DATE_TIME は localtimestamp なので除き、NULL でないことだけを記録）と、シーケンスの状態（null は未使用）。cases の各ケースは、初期状態（PostgreSQL から読み戻した値）、段ごとの結果（rows・count・error）、最後の状態。表の行の順は未規定。knownMismatch はモデルと異なると分かっているケースの分析

flight.exists.sql: SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT * FROM flight WHERE departure_date = $1 AND flight_name = $2 AND boarding_class_cd = $3 AND fare_type_cd = $4 )

flight.findOneForUpdate.sql: SELECT f.departure_date, f.flight_name, f.fare_type_cd, f.vacant_num, f.boarding_class_cd FROM flight f WHERE departure_date = $1 AND flight_name = $2 AND boarding_class_cd = $3 AND fare_type_cd = $4 FOR UPDATE

flight.update.sql: UPDATE flight SET vacant_num = $1 WHERE departure_date = $2 AND flight_name = $3 AND boarding_class_cd = $4 AND fare_type_cd = $5

member.findOne.sql: SELECT m.customer_no, m.kanji_family_name, m.kanji_given_name, m.kana_family_name, m.kana_given_name, m.birthday, m.gender, m.tel, m.zip_code, m.address, m.mail, m.credit_no, m.credit_term, m_l.password, m_l.last_password, m_l.login_date_time, m_l.login_flg, c_t.credit_type_cd, c_t.credit_firm FROM member m, member_login m_l, credit_type c_t WHERE m.customer_no = $1 AND m.customer_no = m_l.customer_no AND m.credit_type_cd = c_t.credit_type_cd

reservation.insert.sql: INSERT INTO reservation ( reserve_no, reserve_date, total_fare, rep_family_name, rep_given_name, rep_age, rep_gender, rep_tel, rep_mail, rep_customer_no ) VALUES ( $1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8, $9, NULLIF($10, '') )

reservation.insertReserveFlight.sql: INSERT INTO reserve_flight ( reserve_flight_no, reserve_no, departure_date, flight_name, boarding_class_cd, fare_type_cd ) VALUES ( $1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6 )

reservation.insertPassenger.sql: INSERT INTO passenger ( passenger_no, reserve_flight_no, family_name, given_name, age, gender, customer_no ) VALUES ( $1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, NULLIF($7, '') )
